description: How to get data from one registry source: its endpoint (copied verbatim, never guessed), API type, whether a key is needed and which env var holds it, an example request, and which MCP server to hand off to (the `socrata` MCP with the right domain, or the matching @betanyc MCP). Flags UNCONFIRMED, undocumented, gated, dead and no-portal rows.

entity.description: Entity name, e.g. 'NYS Department of Health'

limit.description: When several rows match: most to list. Default 25

offset.description: When several rows match: skip this many (next_offset)

registry_id.description: Government body id from BetaNYC/ny-gov-web-registry. Several sources can share one; then the reply lists them

name: how_to_query
